LESSON: HADITH ON GRATITUDE

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on Greetings (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the le
Topic 2.4: Hadith on Gratitude

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on Gratitude. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why should one be grateful to other people?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation
2. practise gratitude in day-to- day life

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HADITH ON GRATITUDE
This lesson teaches Hadith on Gratitude for Grade 5 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. practise gratitude in day-to- day life
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Hadith on Gratitude using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Hadith on Gratitude above.
2. Explain Hadith on Gratitude to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Hadith on Gratitude.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on Gratitude with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on Gratitude important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why should one be grateful to other people?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the Hadith on gratitude for character formation
2. practise gratitude in day-to- day life

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
